opening.argument: The title frames the video as a familiar tech-support call, and the dialogue stays within that premise: a program has crashed, a software error is repeated, and the caller is offered step-by-step help from an engineer. The creator end card reinforces the sketch format. These details establish a workplace parody about troubleshooting, not a pitch to the viewer. Nothing in the described exchange asks the viewer to buy something, invest, make a payment, provide credentials, or accept a deceptive offer. The support process is the subject of the joke, not a solicitation directed at the audience.
